meta.title: Memory Palace (dsh-memory-palace)
meta.description: Local long-term memory: archives older turns under context pressure and reads them back after compaction; supports four tiered hot-memory boards (identity / user 板块 / rules / memories), project documents and project hot memory, memory families with root transfer, manual injection, 20K segmented reading, and tag-based related retrieval. All data stays in the current workspace.
